quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 19

questions.question: On long trips, how can you prevent drowsiness?

options.text: Move your eyes from side to side while driving.

questions.explanation: Take regular stops on long trips. Rest and stretch your body, even if you don't feel tired yet.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means what color light comes next?
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns you that a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: What shape is a stop sign?
questions.explanation: Stop signs are octagon-shaped (eight sides). This shape is only used for stop signs.

questions.question: What does an orange sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction, maintenance, and emergency work areas.

questions.question: Fog makes it hard to see other cars, pedestrians, and traffic signals. What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Do not use your high beam headlights.
Use low beam headlights to see the road and objects better.

questions.explanation: In fog, drive slowly and carefully. Do not use high beams—they reflect off the fog. Use low beams instead. They light up the road and objects better in fog.

questions.question: When must you stop for a school bus?

options.text: When it is parked on the road shoulder with no one in it
When it approaches you, even if lights are not flashing
On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing
Whenever the driver waves at you

questions.correctAnswerText: On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing
questions.explanation: Stop when a school bus shows flashing red lights. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop while the bus picks up or drops off children.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean?

options.text: No passing is allowed from either direction
Passing is allowed from either direction

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing is allowed from either direction
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You cannot cross them except to turn left or to safely pass pedestrians, bicyclists, or scooter riders.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of an intersection ahead.

questions.question: Which substances can impair your driving and result in a DUII arrest?
questions.explanation: Many substances can impair your driving, including alcohol, illegal drugs, prescription medications, over-the-counter medicines, and inhalants.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When slow driving disrupts the normal traffic flow
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving disrupts the normal traffic flow
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you disrupt the normal flow of traffic. You can receive a citation for driving too slowly.

questions.question: How should you safely pass a bicycle?

options.text: Honk to let the bicyclist know you are passing.
Drive in the bicycle lane until you can pass.
Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
Speed up and pull in front of the bicyclist quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: When passing a bicyclist, slow down and give them lots of space. Bicyclists have less protection than car drivers. Passing too quickly can make them lose control.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look both ways, then go if it is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to cross the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells drivers to slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What do orange signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are diamond-shaped with black letters or symbols. They warn drivers that people are working on or near the highway.

questions.question: When a driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing without a traffic light, who must yield?
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection, even without a traffic light or crosswalk.

questions.question: What should a driver do after being in an accident?

options.text: Stop their vehicle at or near the scene.
Do not stand or walk in traffic lanes.
Turn off the engines of wrecked vehicles.

questions.explanation: After an accident, stop at or near the scene. Move your vehicle out of traffic if possible. Stay out of traffic lanes to avoid being hit. Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.question: When there is an oncoming car on your left and a bicyclist on your right, what should you do?

options.text: Let the car pass, then pass the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass, then pass the bicycle.
questions.explanation: Handle one hazard at a time. Let the oncoming car pass first, then pass the bicycle. Do not try to squeeze between both at the same time.

questions.question: How can you prevent hydroplaning?

options.text: Make sure your tires have good tread.
Slow down when driving in rain.

questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, keep tires with good tread depth and proper air pressure. Slow down in the rain. Hydroplaning happens more often at higher speeds.

questions.question: What do work zone signs mean?

options.text: You must stop immediately and back up.
Drive faster to exit the work zone.

questions.explanation: Orange work zone signs mean work is being done on or next to the road. Be extremely careful when you see these signs.

questions.question: What should you do while in a travel lane on the roadway?

options.text: You may stop to drop off passengers.
You may stop to look up an address.
You may make a U-turn or back up if you miss a freeway entrance.
Do not stop. Keep moving until you can safely leave the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not stop. Keep moving until you can safely leave the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road. If you miss your exit, go to the next one instead of backing up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?
questions.explanation: A slow-moving vehicle has a reflective orange triangle on the back. Vehicles with this sign travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: How can you prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Let your vehicle slow down before pressing the brakes.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops make it hard for drivers behind you to stop in time. Release the gas pedal to slow down first. Then press the brake firmly and smoothly. Your brake lights will warn drivers behind you.

questions.question: What should you do if an aggressive driver is behind you?

options.text: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
Look at the driver as they pass you.
Speed up while they are passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
questions.explanation: Move out of the way of an aggressive driver. Do not make eye contact with them. Speeding up will only make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: What usually causes hydroplaning?
questions.explanation: When you drive too fast in wet conditions, your tires cannot clear water from the road. Your tires lose grip and the vehicle slides on water. This is hydroplaning.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator gets stuck while driving?

options.text: Reach down and pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.
questions.explanation: Keep your eyes on the road. Shift into neutral right away and press the brake pedal firmly. When it is safe, pull over and turn off the engine.
